description: This Java source file defines the configuration class OpenmrsPropertyConfig, which provides a Spring bean for property placeholder configuration. It sets up property sources using application data directory and other configuration files, contributing to OpenMRS core configuration management.

classes.name: OpenmrsPropertyConfig
classes.description: Configuration class providing a Spring PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer bean that loads properties from default and runtime configuration files, using the application data directory for the file location.

methods.name: propertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer
methods.description: Creates and configures a PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer bean, setting properties and resource locations for runtime configuration, ensuring the openmrs-runtime.properties file is loaded from the application data directory.
